plugins.name: thing-editor
plugins.description: Thing-Editor (PixiJS v7 game engine) reference: scene/prefab JSON format, component conventions, lifecycle gotchas.

plugins.name: thing-editor-figma-sync
plugins.description: Sync Thing-Editor scene/prefab JSON with Figma. 4 workflows: compare+patch existing scene, validate Figma [Class] name layer naming, scaffold new scene/prefab skeleton from Figma frame, future visual screenshot diff. Soft naming enforcement, flag-driven apply.

plugins.name: thing-editor-deep
plugins.description: Deep architectural reference for Thing-Editor: runtime internals, editor architecture, build pipeline, type system, real game patterns, exhaustive gotcha catalog.

plugins.name: thing-editor-design-review
plugins.description: Automated design-review for Thing-Editor games against Figma. Orchestrates the design-review CLI: drive a headless editor, diff a scene vs its Figma frame, auto-fix the safe subset, triage the rest, emit a before/after compare page.
